correctness.rationale: The ordered maximal radius array determines all interval palindromicity predicates, hence determines each prefix fingerprint. A nonconstant prefix ending in a^r after b≠a gives at most q−2 continuations because append z=a forces a terminal length-two palindrome and z=b forces terminal b a^r b palindrome; if neither palindrome is prescribed, both symbols are prohibited. Initial constant-run length t is fingerprint determined. Every fiber has ≤q(q−1)(q−2)^(n−t−1), strictly below the target unless t=1, and any forced extension causes further strict reduction because q−2≥2. Equality iff every adjacent and distance-two pair differs, equivalent to absence of every palindrome of length ≥2. The unique trivial fingerprint fiber counts q(q−1)(q−2)^(n−2). The n=2 boundary is handled separately. Independent exhaustive enumeration for q=4,n=2..5 and q=5,n=4 confirms finite cases without establishing the all-n result.
